page_about.title: About Edemly
page_about.welcome: We are the Edemly team, and we are happy to welcome you to our messenger!
page_about.goal: Our goal is to create a space where communication and planning complement each other organically. We believe that modern people need not just another messenger, but a tool that helps them not only stay connected, but also manage their time effectively.
page_about.faq_contact_question: How do I add a new contact?
page_about.faq_contact_answer: Use the search function in the main menu. Enter the user's name or email address, and you can start chatting.
page_about.faq_theme_question: How do I customize the theme?
page_about.faq_theme_answer: Go to the main menu and select 'Settings.' There you will find various design options to suit your taste.
page_about.faq_scheduler_question: How does the task scheduler work?
page_about.faq_scheduler_answer: You can create tasks and set deadlines. All tasks are synchronized with your calendar so you can see the full picture of your activities.
page_about.faq_support_answer: If you have any questions or problems, please contact us using the form:
page_about.closing: We create Edemly with you in mind. Every feature is designed to make your life easier and more organized.

page_premium.title: Edemly Premium
page_premium.main_title: Edemly Premium — More opportunities for you!
page_premium.description: Want to use Edemly to its full potential? Upgrade to Premium and get advanced planning and organization features!
page_premium.feature1_desc: The free version offers a limited number of notes. With Premium, you can create as many notes as you need — for work, study, personal matters, and creative ideas.
page_premium.feature2_desc: Create an unlimited number of reminders with flexible settings.
page_premium.feature3_desc: Access premium themes and fine-tune the interface to suit your style.
page_premium.feature4_desc: Your questions will be handled first — we are always ready to help our users.
page_premium.note: *After your subscription ends, you will retain an unlimited number of notes.
